summary: Gemini API key provider swap FULLY VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend 7/7 tests PASS in 22.51s (/app/backend/tests/test_gemini_swap.py). (A) POST /api/ai/research with fresh PN 95400-<uuid> Hyundai+Kia -> HTTP 200, verification='Requires Verification' (NOT Verified), approval_status='Pending', from_database=false, grounded=bool, confidence=int, result.status in {SUCCESS, NOT_FOUND}, result.compatible_vehicles=list, result.cross_reference=list. Direct curl smoke returned confidence=85 SUCCESS with rich structured data (name='Integrated Body Control Unit', 3 compatible_vehicles, 3 cross_references, 2 sources) proving Gemini gemini-3.7-flash non-grounded fallback works even without billing. (B) POST /api/ai/research/{id}/approve with edits {name:'Test BCM', compatible_vehicles:['Hyundai Creta'], variant:'BS6', year:'2020', category:'Electrical/Body Control'} -> ok, GET /api/parts/{pn} confirms verification_status='Verified', name='Test BCM', compatible_vehicles=['Hyundai Creta']. (C) Re-POST /api/ai/research same PN under 15s timeout -> returned in <10s with from_database=true, verification='Verified', confidence=100, approval_status='Approved', result.status='SUCCESS', result.compatible_vehicles=['Hyundai Creta'] — proving DB-FIRST short-circuits Gemini. Honest labeling contract holds: AI branch NEVER self-marks Verified. Core endpoints unaffected: /api/categories total=73, /api/buy increments stock to 1, /api/sell decrements to 0, /api/stats returns total_parts. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844, admin abdul/Salam@123): tapped module-search, searched fresh PN 95400-UI599, tapped Run AI Research, waited ~35s, AI card rendered with YELLOW 'Requires Verification' chip + 'Pending' chip + Confidence meter + explanation text + 'Review, Edit & Approve' + 'Reject' + 'Re-run AI' buttons — Gemini honestly returned status=NOT_FOUND / confidence=0 for the synthetic PN (per contract this is a PASS, not a failure). No red screen, no 5xx, no new react-native issues. Two pre-existing dev-only warnings persist (harmless, already noted iter 3/6): props.pointerEvents deprecated. GEMINI_API_KEY + GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.7-flash swap is production-ready.
